messages:
Zoe Chen: Heads up — SeniorBank POC asked for SOC 2 artifact pack + pen-test attestation for legal review. They want stuff by EOD Thursday. Can we confirm what we can hand off and who owns it? cc @Anya Rodriguez @Tom Nguyen
Mike Patel: From the POC/pricing side: they also want a short note on data residency and whether logs include PII. Procurement needs that.
Anya Rodriguez: I can produce an SOC 2 evidence list (control mapping + redacted report) and a pen-test attestation letter. Need to confirm allowed disclosure — we do NOT share raw vuln reports. Who signs the attestation? Security lead or Legal?
Tom Nguyen: Eng infra can export the arch diagram + network boundaries and confirm KMS usage and VPC details. We can also provide a retention statement. Need a ticket with exact scope to pull configs.
Zoe Chen: I'll ask the customer to accept: (1) redacted SOC 2 report, (2) attestation letter, (3) architecture diagram. They also want an audit contact for follow-ups.
Mike Patel: Quick pricing Q — if we hand these artifacts during a free POC does that change licensing expectations? Also: do we require an NDA before sending attestation? cc @Legal
Anya Rodriguez: We should avoid any sensitive test findings. Standard approach: provide an attestation letter signed by Security Lead stating we maintain SOC 2 and that a third-party pen-test was completed on scope X. I'll draft the template. Also include explicit line: "No customer data was used in testing."
audits-bot: New compliance request created: CR-2028. Assigned to Anya Rodriguez, Tom Nguyen. Link: https://redwood.internal/compliance/CR-2028
Tom Nguyen: Adding a checklist to eng-infra ticket: diagrams (high-level only), network boundaries, KMS/HSM statement, retention policy excerpt. ETA: tomorrow EOD for exports.
Zoe Chen: Customer confirmed attestation-only is acceptable. Mike — can you confirm a short pricing blurb so I can reply? They also asked about POC credential rotation schedule.
Mike Patel: Will send pricing blurb by 3pm. POC creds: rotate weekly by default, can be configured daily on request.
Anya Rodriguez: Draft attestation uploaded to S3 for review: `s3://redwood-compliance/seniorbank/attestation-draft.pdf`. Please review and I will loop in Legal for signature.
Zoe Chen: Perfect — please ping @Mike Patel and @Legal when finalized. I'll notify SeniorBank and give them the audit contact (Zoe Chen) for any follow-ups.
Tom Nguyen: Noted. I'll attach exported diagrams to the ticket and include cmd snippet for archive download: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-compliance/seniorbank/arch-diagram.svg ./`
Mike Patel: Thanks all — once Legal signs attestation and eng uploads artifacts I will update procurement note and reply to the customer.
Anya Rodriguez: Thanks — I'll iterate the attestation template and confirm signature owner.
Zoe Chen: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
